bio: The Grom brothers run their restaurant in the centre of this small town. As part of the highly professional front-of-house team, sommelier Niklas provides astute recommendations from the impressive wine list. Meanwhile, Jason presides in the kitchen, cooking up ambitious modern dishes. There is a choice of two set menus: burg and the vegetarian gartenliebe, with all courses also available individually. Tempting dishes include creamy Parmigiano Reggiano ravioli with grilled leek and rum-soaked raisins. Classics such as Zwiebelrostbraten (steak with onions and gravy) and Wiener schnitzel can be ordered à la carte.
